verdict.rationale: Godot exposes stable, versioned engine APIs (GDScript/C# class reference, GDExtension) that third-party tools and AI agents could rely on, so this axis is fair to ask, but the evidence pack contains no documentation of a formal API versioning scheme or deprecation policy — only general docs on scripting, plugins, and CLI usage. No changelog, compatibility guarantee, or deprecation notice is cited anywhere in the pack.
